answer: Standing decays each epoch an identity leaves unspent, and the score is rebuilt from attested tasks only, weighted by the length of independent paths that reached them, so a ring vouching for itself earns what one agent would. Idle history cools to an ember in four epochs while the kernel of past work stays readable. An attacker needs separate live paths on the graph, which costs more identities than a farm can keep answering; the mesa of parked keys pays nothing.
